notes: v3 (paid-launch 2026-10-25): value-first rebuild of final-v2. Copy states benefits in short beats instead of listing operations; same take, same crop/mask/upscale.

Order is not chronological: audio-ending (41.6) follows video-playing (55.6) and save-while-playing (34.4) comes after the auto-advance library (48.8). Each shot is shown as recorded; no state is implied that the take does not contain. The auto-advance library shows the finished audio row (played/saved) and the next item (video) playing in the mini player.

Offline claim: save-while-playing shows the download control turning into the saved state; offline-saved-library shows both rows with the saved badge. Offline playback of saved files is a shipped feature of 1.0.0 (8) (App Store description: ダウンロードし、オフライン再生).
No price, no date, no device frame, no synthetic UI. All overlays are text only. Login requirement is stated on the last frame without implying that the built-in demo needs sign-in.

Library items: original chord sketch AAC (project-owned) and NASA GSFC SVS 12118 Earth Time-lapse with its audio removed; rights in candidate8/app-preview/media/RIGHTS.md. NASA credit is shown small on the 2.4 s video shot only.
Upscale 480x1040 -> 886x1920 (x1.846, lanczos); UI text in the footage is soft at full size. Copy is rendered at output resolution and stays sharp.

Parent review 2026-10-25 (take2 contact sheet): offline library shortened to 3.2 s; closing title (brand + value + login requirement) moved onto a different real screen, the audio Now Playing sheet (source 29.0-34.0) darkened with black@0.76; brand and value sit inside the artwork area, the requirement in the empty band below the option row (no overlap with the dimmed UI text). The requirement is 40 px for about 3.5 s and is on the last frame.
